firm_data.firm_description: McCarter & English, LLP is a firm of more than 400 lawyers with offices in Newark, New York, Boston, Philadelphia, Washington, DC, Miami, Wilmington, Hartford, Stamford, Indianapolis, East Brunswick, and Trenton. In continuous business for 180 years, we are among the oldest and largest law firms in America.

email.subject: AI for McCarter & English — built for firms managing your scale
email.body:
Hi Richard,

With 400 lawyers across 12 offices and three major acquisitions in the last decade, McCarter & English has mastered growth. But managing complex litigation, IP, and transactional work at that scale while integrating new practices requires tooling most firms don't have.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner operational teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on precision, client trust, and efficiency—especially during integration.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast region. I'd be happy to stop by Newark to show how—as ex-lawyers ourselves—we're helping firms like McCarter & English compete and scale without adding headcount.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
